title: Göbekli Tepe chalices and burial rituals

tellings.quote: But Brian also mentions archaeologically excavated chalices at Göbekli Tepe, which dates back 12,000 years ago, right before the agrarian revolution.

plain: At Göbekli Tepe, an ancient site said to date back 12,000 years, just before people began farming, archaeologists are said to have dug up chalices tied to rituals, including burial rites. Michels takes this from a book called The Immortality Key by a writer named Brian Muraresku, as a hint that ritual drinks may be older than agriculture itself.
